highlights: Leading AI labs are rapidly deploying new multimodal models, including Mistral's 1.05T parameter MoE and OpenAI's GPT-6 with intelligent UI, pushing the boundaries of capability and accessibility.

Significant advancements are being made in AI agent reliability and trustworthiness, with new methods for auditing black-box LLM agents, enhancing coding agent performance, and benchmarking self-evolving skill packages.

The AI ecosystem is maturing through crucial developer tools, such as a CLI for integrating open models with proprietary environments and open-sourcing production-grade solutions for complex optimization, alongside major enterprise partnerships and new monetization strategies like advertising in ChatGPT.

agents.title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
agents.summary: This research outlines a framework for improving autonomous coding agents by enhancing location and edit diversity, alongside refined verification, leading to substantial gains in pass rates and reduced false acceptance on coding benchmarks.

agents.title: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities
agents.summary: A novel, training-free method uses a low-cost open-weight surrogate model to audit black-box LLM agents for silent errors in tool calls and code, significantly improving error detection and decision-making accuracy without internal access.

agents.title: SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown
agents.summary: Introduces SkillScriptBench, a 350-task benchmark for evaluating agent skill self-evolution, alongside AST-Guided Skill Revision, which substantially improves script and documentation repair success and consistency across LLM agents.

models.title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
models.summary: Mistral AI has launched Mistral Large 4, a 1.05 trillion parameter Mixture of Experts (MoE) model with native image input and a 1 million token context window, now live via API with open weights expected soon, pushing multimodal capabilities.

models.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
models.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 globally within ChatGPT, featuring an Intelligent UI that delivers faster responses with integrated visuals and interactive experiences, making advanced AI more intuitive and broadly accessible.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models With Zero Output Tokens
models.summary: Liquid AI has released Open d1, open-weight multimodal decision models (d1-3B, d1-omni-600M) that process text, images, or audio to return calibrated, typed answers in a single pass with zero output tokens, enabling real-time, low-latency decisions.

tools.title: Meet Together Link: A Free CLI That Runs Open Models Inside Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode
tools.summary: Together AI has released Together Link, a free, MIT-licensed CLI that enables developers to connect popular proprietary AI code environments (like Claude Code, Codex) to open-source models, offering significant cost savings and flexibility.

tools.title: Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day
tools.summary: Meta has open-sourced Rebalancer, a high-performance C++ and Python library for solving complex assignment problems, battle-tested for over nine years in Meta's production, handling 40 million placements daily.

tools.title: ROAR: Unifying Runs across Heterogeneous AI-Driven Research Systems
tools.summary: ROAR introduces new infrastructure to unify and analyze outputs from diverse AI-driven research systems, providing a relational schema and parsing layer to aggregate and compare experimental runs for large-scale R&D insights and reproducibility.

companies.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
companies.summary: OpenAI is introducing new visual ad formats within ChatGPT and expanding measurement tools and brand suitability partnerships, signaling a significant move to monetize its conversational AI platform for advertisers.

companies.title: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
companies.summary: Atlassian and OpenAI are deepening their collaboration to integrate frontier AI models with enterprise knowledge bases, empowering teams to streamline planning, building, and delivery of work across Atlassian products.

companies.title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
companies.summary: Radisson Hotel Group has partnered with Accenture to develop a ChatGPT plugin, enabling travelers to use OpenAI technology for finding, comparing, and booking hotels directly within their trip planning process.

learning.title: A Developer’s Guide to Laya: Zero-Shot Decisions and Calibration
learning.summary: This comprehensive guide provides developers with practical steps to implement typed decisions, fit custom temperatures, and build reliable abstention gates using Laya, an open-source zero-shot decision engine.

learning.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
learning.summary: OpenAI has published a practical guide for startups on effectively choosing, tuning, and improving prompts and skills for GPT-6 models, as well as coordinating tools and preparing AI workflows for production environments.

learning.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
learning.summary: OpenAI is launching a College Planner within ChatGPT for Teens, alongside new flashcards and quizzes, and forming a teen AI council, providing educational tools and fostering AI literacy among young users.
